parameters.value: ={{ $('Format Alert Message').item.json.message }} — Process this canteen alert, update tasks panel, and be ready to answer Ajay's follow-up questions.

_comment: SETUP: 1) Import into n8n. 2) Set env vars in n8n: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY, TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN, TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. 3) Create the Supabase RPC function get_today_summary (SQL below). 4) Activate. SUPABASE SQL: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_today_summary() RETURNS json AS $$ SELECT json_build_object('total_sales', COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0), 'transaction_count', COUNT(*), 'date', CURRENT_DATE) FROM sales WHERE date = CURRENT_DATE; $$ LANGUAGE sql SECURITY DEFINER;
